entities.summary: David Jeffrey Bednar, nicknamed "the Bednar Bandit" and El Oso, is an American professional baseball pitcher for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the San Diego Padres and Pittsburgh Pirates. The Padres selected Bednar in the 35th round of the 2016 MLB draft.
